about.en: Taiyo Yuden Co., Ltd. is a Japanese electronic components maker that describes itself as a global manufacturer producing the world's smallest multilayer ceramic capacitors, alongside inductors, EMI suppression filters, varistors, FBAR and SAW devices, chip antennas and power storage devices. 6976 represents its common shares listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, which derivative markets quote under the TAIYOYUDEN ticker, and is distinct from the over-the-counter American depositary receipts traded in the US under TYOYY.
